title: Swimming Lessons for Kids in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Berliner Bäder courses have no waitlist.** Each term is sold online; the courses starting in **January 2027** go on sale at the **end of November 2026**, with the plan online in early November.
**The Seepferdchen course starts at age 5:** 20 lessons of 45 minutes, usually twice a week, **EUR 210** at the child rate including entry. Lessons are in German only.
**Club and DLRG places are cheaper but slow:** the DLRG in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg had about **370 children** waiting in May 2026, and a place can take **two to three years**.
**School swimming is in Year 3,** and the standard is the **Bronze** badge: 200 metres in 15 minutes and a 2-metre dive.
**Free holiday courses** run in the Easter, summer and autumn breaks for pupils in **Year 4 to 10** with no Seepferdchen or Bronze, announced about 4 to 6 weeks ahead on schwimmkurse-sportjugend.de.
**My move:** a club list at three, a Berliner Bäder course on the sale day at five, and the Seepferdchen before Year 3.
